description: Figure 4.1, titled "WER during fine-tuning Whisper model with different amount of weights," is a composite of four line plots arranged in a 2x2 grid, each illustrating the Word Error Rate (WER) over a series of epochs for different model configurations. The top-left plot, labeled "Whisper fine-tuning, type = tiny," shows the WER for four variants of the tiny model: "tiny AdaLoRA_int4" (solid grey line with square markers), "tiny AdaLoRA_int8" (dashed grey line with square markers), "tiny int4" (dotted grey line with circle markers), and "tiny int8" (dashed grey line with triangle markers). All four lines start at a WER of approximately 70 at epoch 0 and decrease over the 6 epochs, with the "tiny AdaLoRA_int4" and "tiny AdaLoRA_int8" models showing the lowest WERs, converging to around 40, while the "tiny int4" and "tiny int8" models remain higher, around 45. The top-right plot, "Whisper fine-tuning, type = base," displays the WER for four base models: "base AdaLoRA_int4" (solid blue line with square markers), "base AdaLoRA_int8" (dashed blue line with square markers), "base int4" (dotted blue line with circle markers), and "base full" (dashed blue line with triangle markers). All lines start at a WER of approximately 60 and decrease, with the "base AdaLoRA_int4" and "base AdaLoRA_int8" models showing the lowest WERs, ending around 40, while the "base int4" and "base full" models remain higher, around 45. The bottom-left plot, "Whisper fine-tuning, type = medium," shows the WER for four medium models: "medium AdaLoRA_int4" (solid green line with square markers), "medium AdaLoRA_int8" (dashed green line with square markers), "medium int4" (dotted green line with circle markers), and "medium int8" (dashed green line with triangle markers). All lines start at a WER of approximately 30 and decrease, with the "medium AdaLoRA_int4" and "medium AdaLoRA_int8" models showing the lowest WERs, ending around 20, while the "medium int4" and "medium int8" models remain higher, around 25. The bottom-right plot, "Whisper fine-tuning, type = large," shows the WER for four large models: "large AdaLoRA_int4" (solid purple line with square markers), "large AdaLoRA_int8" (dashed purple line with square markers), "large int4" (dotted purple line with circle markers), and "large int8" (dashed purple line with triangle markers). All lines start at a WER of approximately 25 and decrease, with the "large AdaLoRA_int4" and "large AdaLoRA_int8" models showing the lowest WERs, ending around 15, while the "large int4" and "large int8" models remain higher, around 20. In all plots, the x-axis represents the epoch, ranging from 0 to 6, and the y-axis represents the WER, with values ranging from 10 to 70.
